Subject: Need help with a cheque bounce case

Hello, my name is Meera Shah. I am a 50-year-old bank manager living in Ahmedabad. Shruti More gave me a cheque for Rs 32,90,000 to repay a loan, but the cheque came back with the remark account closed. My case number is CC/1706/2021 in the Judicial Magistrate First Class Court at Ahmedabad. Can your firm advise me on what to do next? You can call me on 08692132446 or email meera.shah@example.in.

spans.text: Judicial Magistrate First Class Court at Ahmedabad
age (50) + occupation (bank manager) + city (Ahmedabad) + issue (cheque bounce)
